Name: Monster Stats
Author: HamBandit
Description:
[center][/center][center][/center][center]﻿﻿﻿
Monster Stats is a mod that allows you to adjust the stat values of most of the monsters in the game.

This mod can be used to make the game much easier, or much, much harder!

Most monsters can have their [b]Damage[/b], [b]Defense[/b], [b]Drop Rates, [/b][b]Health[/b], [b]Speed, [/b]and [b]EXP [/b]adjusted to whatever values you like!

Use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make editing the monster stats even easier.

Monsters that are spawned are not affected by changes made to their mob type, only monsters spawned after the changes are made will be affected.

[b]BE VERY CAREFUL WHEN CHANGING MONSTER VALUES TO HIGH NUMBERS![/b]

[b]A CONFIG IS INCLUDED WITH THE FOLLOWING CHANGES:[/b]
[b]☆[/b] Golems health increased by 100%
[b]☆ [/b]Dust Sprites health decreased by 50%
[b]☆[/b] Skeleton damage increased by 50%
[b]☆[/b] Slime damage decreased by 20%
[b]☆[/b] Crab defense increased by 100%
[b]☆[/b] Shadow monsters defense decreased by 50%
[b]☆[/b] Bat speed increased by 33%
[b]☆ [/b]Mummy speed decreased by 25%
[b]☆[/b] Serpent damage, defense, health, and speed increased by 50%
[b]☆[/b] Serpent experience increased by 100%

Selecting "Restore Defaults" in the Generic Mod Config menu or simply not including the supplied config in your mod folder will set all creatures to Vanilla stats.
[b]
------
[/b]
[b]PLEASE NOTE!!!
Decimals do not work with this system, and will cause whatever monster has a decimal in one of their values to not spawn![/b]

[size=1][i]This mod has a slight incompatibility with SVE's "StrongerMonsters" config setting, since they essentially overwrite each other. I would recommend setting SVE's [/i]
[i]"StrongerMonsters" to false when using this mod.[/i]
